mil7.7.8:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, māgavikassa cattāri angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni cattāri angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.7.8:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena appamiddhena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.8:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja māgavikassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.8:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja māgaviko migesu yeva cittaṃ upanibandhati,
mil7.7.8:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ārammaṇesu yeva cittaṃ upanibandhitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.8:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja māgavikassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.8:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja māgaviko kālaṃ kammassa jānāti,
mil7.7.8:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena paṭisallāṇassa kālo jānitabbo: ayaṃ kālo paṭisallāṇassa, ayaṃ kālo nikkhamanāyāti.
mil7.7.8:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja māgavikassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.8:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja māgaviko migaṃ disvā hāsamabhijaneti: imaṃ lacchāmīti,
mil7.7.8:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ārammaṇe abhiramitabbaṃ, hāsamabhijanetabbaṃ: uttariṃ visesam-adhigacchissāmīti.
mil7.7.8:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja māgavikassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
